name: X-Legend Entertainment Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating alongside its various subsidiaries, X-Legend Entertainment Co., Ltd. is actively involved in the creation, production, distribution, and promotion of both online and mobile gaming titles. Its diverse portfolio of games is released in roughly 14 different languages, reaching players across a broad international spectrum, including Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japan, mainland China, North America, South Korea, Germany, France, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Portugal, Spain, Italy, and Russia. Their product range encompasses massively multiplayer online (MMO) games, along with more relaxed casual and puzzle genres. Furthermore, they provide specialized data and software services. The firm also participates in global trading activities, manages intellectual property assets, and delivers information software solutions. Established in 2002, X-Legend Entertainment Co., Ltd. has its primary operations based in Taipei, Taiwan.
